verdict.rationale: Custom MCP servers let you expose only selected tools, such as subscription and invoice lookup, to an AI client. This limits what an agent can reach through MCP. The API key docs only show creating a 'Full-Access Key'; the wording hints other key types exist, but restricted or read-only keys are never documented. missing for 10: documented restricted/read-only or per-resource API key scopes, per-agent credential issuance and revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
